description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for the HTTP Proxy Session Object, including function prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization of the object.

methods.name: HttpCreateProxySession
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP Proxy Session object with given context handles.

methods.name: HttpPsoCreate
methods.description: Creates the HTTP Proxy Session object instance.

methods.name: HttpPsoRemove
methods.description: Removes the HTTP Proxy Session object instance.

methods.name: HttpPsoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary internal objects for the HTTP Proxy Session.

methods.name: HttpPsoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP Proxy Session object.
